Responsibility Map

Each pipe stage names the system that should act first. Downstream cells become blocked when an upstream chokepoint makes their output untrustworthy.
Source systemsPublisher freshness and whether new content exists at all.
Muse / raw captureScrape, export, and hand raw bytes to the repo import path.
Repo import and transformSupabase imports, manifests, matching, references, reindexing, tests.
ChatGPT / CodexPromotion decisions, rule enforcement, deploy checks, handoffs.
PresentationBrowser code, labels, diagnostics, and public dashboard behavior.
